item.title: Making 'I Play Rocky' Felt Like A Throwback To 1976 For The Creators - Contenders L.A.
item.description: The team behind I Play Rocky found themselves time-traveling 50 years into the past to capture the essence of the story of how an unknown Sylvester Stallone wrote and starred in Rocky, the blockbuster.

item.title: Dragon Ball Daima Deserves to Return for Season 2
item.description: Image Courtesy of Toei Animation Dragon Ball Daima did a great job filling in some of the gaps between Dragon Ball Z and Dragon Ball Super, but the ending still left some unanswered questions.

item.title: Apple TV's Pluribus Confirms a Bigger Role for One Favorite Character in Season 2
item.description: Well, Pluribus fans, it looks like one of your favorite side characters is getting a whole lot more spotlight in the series' second season, which is currently in production, though no official release date has been announced.
